display_name: The whole Business Names Registration Act 2014 as fact-record rules: registration and its exemptions, business names, the Registrar's powers, notice duties as regulative rules, offences, service and transitional provisions
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 30 Sep 2026: ss 1 to 45; the Act has no Schedules. Inert (no condition or answer of their own): s 1, 2(4) to (6), 3, 4(5), 6(2), 17(5), (10), 20(5), 26(4), 27(6), 29(1), (4), 30(4), 31(8), 33(2), 34(2), 39(2), (3), 40(5), 44 and the savings in s 45; NOTES.md section 2 gives each reason. NOT encoded: the other Acts the Act points at (Companies Act 1967, Limited Liability Partnerships Act 2005, Limited Partnerships Act 2008, National Registration Act 1965, Charities Act 1994, Central Provident Fund Act 1953, Trade Marks Act 1998), whose answers are facts in the records; and every regulation the Minister may make (ss 2(3)(l), 4(1)(p), 6(1)(b)(ix), 7(1), 8, 24(3), 28, 37, 40(6), 43), none of which is an input: an input fact where a fact can stand in, a named REFUSE (ss 37, 40(6), 43) where nothing can. Law stated as at 2026-09-30 (the PDF banner).

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the statute. An independent test pass was run on 2026-09-30 (tests-independent.l4, 599 assertions, no disagreement), but its author read the modules for names and signatures, and it is not a substitute for expert review. The pipeline has not been run. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation and was not compared with an authoritative text. NOTES.md section 6.

forks.F1: s 16(4)(a): the number of 60-day extensions is a fact.
forks.F2: s 17(3)(a): limbs (i) and (ii) read as alternatives.
forks.F3: s 2(3): a foreign company is not treated as carrying on business if it does an activity in (a) to (l) and has no other reason.
forks.F4: s 2(1) 'individual': an administrator etc counts only with direct control.
forks.F5: ss 9(b), 12(1)(a)(ii), 13(1): the certificate makes the Registrar's satisfaction established.
forks.F6: s 16(3)(b): the certificate is not read into the reservation provision.
forks.F7: s 24(1): a cancellation under s 12(1) cannot be restored, as printed.
forks.F9: s 17(2): the anniversary date counts as the period having passed.
forks.F11: s 14(3): cancellation from the day after the last day of the period.
forks.F12: s 23(2)(b): 30 days run from the date of the notice.
forks.F13: s 39(1): an unmade-good default is tested at the date the court considers the application.
forks.F14: ss 8(7), 12(4), 13(2), (3): the certificate excludes appeal only where the decision rests on it.
forks.F15: s 42(2)(e): the date, not the time of day, is used.
